fact: On 19 August 2025 the NCRA, NatCA and mobile network operators signed an MOU on NIN-SIM integration; a technical committee had integrated NCRA's database with operators' systems, enabling real-time cross-checking of subscriber information.
title: To fast-track NIN integration with telecom services... NCRA, NatCA sign MOU with MNOs for NIN-SIM linkage
